Walk-in-Interview for appointing Guest Faculty in English
Walk-in-Interview for the appointment of Guest Faculty in the Subject of English for the
academic session 2023-2024 will be held on 05.10.2023 at Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab
University, Chandigarh at 02:30 PM. The eligible candidates are required to report in the
Committee Room, Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh at 01:00 PM on
05.10.2023 for the verification of applications/documents.

All the applicants (who are eligible as per UGC/PU norms are advised to bring their original
certificates and other relevant documents including publications with photo copies of
certificates and 02 passport Size photographs) for verification along with duly filled forms giving
the details at the time of interview.
No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
The application forms for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
(http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php).
